scope: Canonical relationship graph for the 30 active scientific repositories. The portfolio is one ecological research system, while every repository and series retains independent evidence ownership.

relation_types.handoff: A later project explicitly starts from a question, uncertainty, or bounded object left by the earlier project. Solid directed relation.
relation_types.epistemic: A fixed transformation or ordering of scientific questions; no software/data dependency or retroactive validation. Dashed directed relation.
relation_types.abstraction: A specific scientific problem motivates or instantiates a more general theory/method. Dotted directed relation.
relation_types.provenance: Developmental ancestry or origin-of-question relation; not current scientific dependence. Fine dotted directed relation.
relation_types.complement: Two projects solve complementary parts of a larger task without transferring evidence ownership. Bidirectional relation.
relation_types.component: Parallel companion theory supplies one declared obligation to a synthesis hub; siblings are not sequential chapters. Dotted directed relation.
relation_types.information_flow: Direction in which a bounded scientific or operational object passes, which may differ from research-development chronology. Solid directed relation.
relation_types.shared_substrate: Two projects use the same taxon, archive, dataset or empirical system under different frozen inferential contracts. Shared substrate never merges endpoints or claims.

standalone_programmes.question: Has a proposed ecological state/proxy earned endpoint-relevant predictive status, does its representation preserve the intended information, and only then may residual context or cross-study synthesis be interpreted?
